results.question: What is the difference in the total quantity of products sold in the 'apparel' category between this year and last year?
results.gold_sql: SELECT product_category, (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END)) as quantity_diff FROM sales WHERE product_category = 'Apparel' GROUP BY product_category;
results.baseline_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM sales) THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM sales) THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM sales WHERE product_category = 'Apparel'
results.pipeline_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS current_year_quantity,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_quantity
FROM sales
WHERE product_category = 'Apparel';

SELECT 
    (current_year_quantity - last_year_quantity) AS difference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS current_year_quantity,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_quantity
    FROM sales
    WHERE product_category = 'Apparel'
);

results.question: Which mental health conditions were treated most frequently in Canada during 2022?
results.gold_sql: SELECT conditions.condition, COUNT(conditions.condition) AS count FROM conditions JOIN patients ON conditions.patient_id = patients.id JOIN treatments ON patients.id = treatments.patient_id WHERE patients.country = 'Canada' AND treatments.treatment_date >= '2022-01-01' AND treatments.treatment_date < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY conditions.condition ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1;
results.baseline_sql: SELECT condition FROM patients JOIN conditions ON patients.id = conditions.patient_id WHERE country = 'Canada' AND treatment_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY condition ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
results.pipeline_sql:
SELECT conditions.condition, COUNT(conditions.condition) AS count 
FROM conditions 
JOIN patients ON conditions.patient_id = patients.id 
WHERE patients.country = 'Canada' AND conditions.condition IN (SELECT condition FROM conditions WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT id FROM patients WHERE country = 'Canada') AND treatment_date >= '2022-01-01' AND treatment_date < '2023-01-01'))
GROUP BY conditions.condition 
ORDER BY count DESC 
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Who has the highest number of wins as a coach for each team in a season?
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.TeamID, c.CoachName, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.HomeTeamResult = 'Win' THEN 1 END) + COUNT(CASE WHEN a.HomeTeamResult = 'Win' THEN 1 END) AS Wins FROM Coach c LEFT JOIN Match h ON c.TeamID = h.HomeTeamID AND h.HomeTeamResult = 'Win' LEFT JOIN Match a ON c.TeamID = a.AwayTeamID AND a.HomeTeamResult = 'Win' GROUP BY c.TeamID, c.CoachName ORDER BY Wins DESC;
results.baseline_sql: SELECT T1.TeamID, T2.CoachName, COUNT(*) AS WinCount FROM Match AS T3 JOIN Coach AS T2 ON (T3.HomeTeamResult = 'Win' AND T3.HomeTeamID = T2.TeamID) OR (T3.HomeTeamResult = 'Loss' AND T3.AwayTeamID = T2.TeamID) GROUP BY T1.TeamID, T2.CoachName ORDER BY WinCount DESC LIMIT 1;
results.pipeline_sql:
SELECT CoachID, CoachName, HomeTeamID AS TeamID, COUNT(DISTINCT MatchID) AS TotalWins 
FROM Coach 
JOIN Match ON (Coach.TeamID = Match.HomeTeamID AND Match.HomeTeamResult = 'Win') OR (Coach.TeamID = Match.AwayTeamID AND Match.AwayTeamResult = 'Win')
GROUP BY CoachID, CoachName, HomeTeamID
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT MatchID) DESC;

results.question: What is the maximum consecutive number of days with a financial wellbeing score below 60 for each customer?
results.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, MAX(consecutive_below_60) FROM (SELECT customer_id, score_date, financial_wellbeing_score, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE financial_wellbeing_score < 60) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY score_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS consecutive_below_60 FROM customer_scores) subquery GROUP BY customer_id;
results.baseline_sql: SELECT customer_id, MAX(consecutive_days) as max_consecutive_below_60 FROM ( SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as consecutive_days FROM customer_scores WHERE financial_wellbeing_score < 60 GROUP BY customer_id, date - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY score_date) ) GROUP BY customer_id
results.pipeline_sql:
WITH consecutive_days AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        score_date,
        date_diff = (score_date - INTERVAL '1 day' * ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY score_date)),
        is_below_60 = CASE WHEN financial_wellbeing_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM 
        customer_scores
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    MAX(consecutive_days) as max_consecutive_days_below_60
FROM (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        consecutive_days,
        SUM(is_below_60) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, date_diff ORDER BY score_date) as group_id
    FROM 
        consecutive_days
    WHERE 
        is_below_60 = 1
) subquery
GROUP BY 
    customer_id, date_diff;
